required.name: cost_entries_no_truncate
required.definition: CREATE TRIGGER cost_entries_no_truncate BEFORE TRUNCATE ON public.cost_entries FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION cost_entries_refuse_mutation()

required.name: cost_entries_no_update_delete
required.definition: CREATE TRIGGER cost_entries_no_update_delete BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.cost_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cost_entries_refuse_mutation()

required.name: cost_entries_reversal_guard
required.definition: CREATE TRIGGER cost_entries_reversal_guard BEFORE INSERT ON public.cost_entries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION cost_entries_check_reversal()

required.name: cost_entries_reversal_shape
required.definition: CHECK (((("reversalOfId" IS NULL) AND (amount >= (0)::numeric) AND (upper("uniqueSourceId") !~~ 'REVERSAL:%'::text)) OR (("reversalOfId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("reversalOfId" <> id) AND (amount <= (0)::numeric) AND ("uniqueSourceId" = ('REVERSAL:'::text || ("reversalOfId")::text)))))

required.name: cost_entries_check_reversal
cost_entries_refuse_mutation
required.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.cost_entries_refuse_mutation()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'posted costs are immutable; append a linked reversal'
    USING ERRCODE = 'check_violation', CONSTRAINT = 'cost_entries_immutable';
END;
$function$

required.name: service_tickets_assessment_required
required.definition: CHECK (((status = 'OPEN'::"TicketStatus") OR (("assessmentSnapshot" IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof("assessmentSnapshot") = 'object'::text))))

required.name: service_tickets_confirmation_complete
required.definition: CHECK ((((status <> 'CLOSED'::"TicketStatus") AND ("confirmedBy" IS NULL) AND ("confirmationChannel" IS NULL) AND ("confirmedAt" IS NULL) AND ("closedAt" IS NULL)) OR ((status = 'CLOSED'::"TicketStatus") AND ("confirmedBy" IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim("confirmedBy")) > 0) AND ("confirmationChannel" IS NOT NULL) AND ("confirmedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("closedAt" IS NOT NULL))))

required.name: service_tickets_confirmation_ordered
required.definition: CHECK ((("confirmedAt" IS NULL) OR (("resolvedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("confirmedAt" >= "resolvedAt") AND ("closedAt" >= "confirmedAt"))))

required.name: service_tickets_replacement_complete
required.definition: CHECK (((("replacedUnitId" IS NULL) AND ("newUnitId" IS NULL) AND ("replacementSnapshot" IS NULL)) OR (("replacedUnitId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("newUnitId" IS NOT NULL) AND ("replacementSnapshot" IS NOT NULL) AND (jsonb_typeof("replacementSnapshot") = 'object'::text) AND ("replacedUnitId" = "unitId") AND ("newUnitId" <> "replacedUnitId"))))

required.name: service_tickets_resolution_required
required.definition: CHECK (((status <> ALL (ARRAY['AWAITING_CUSTOMER_CONFIRMATION'::"TicketStatus", 'CLOSED'::"TicketStatus"])) OR (("resolutionDetails" IS NOT NULL) AND (length(btrim("resolutionDetails")) > 0) AND ("resolvedAt" IS NOT NULL))))

required.name: subsidy_milestones_dates_ordered
required.definition: CHECK ((("approvalDate" IS NULL) OR (("submissionDate" IS NOT NULL) AND ("approvalDate" >= "submissionDate"))))
